scope: Targeted eight-book review of ten recurring allies. Observations are dated when revealed, not assumed acquisition dates. Unknown skill ranks stay null. Unnamed abilities are story observations; summoned weapons and item summons are not invented trained skills.
knownGaps: Not a complete inventory: the novels rarely expose full ally loadouts. Absence of a later mention is not proof of retention or loss.
Supplemental prose requires separate reveal-position mapping and is not published by this audit.
Figures and scrolls are not assumed to remain unused indefinitely; exact current quantities are usually unknown.
